objects.description: During the [2026 U.S. Water Utilities Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0066), the adversary altered the control logic (e.g., project files) of internet-exposed PLCs, producing ladder logic discrepancies, changing how the affected controller interacted with its process, after gaining access through default credentials.(Citation: Tenable Minnesota Water Utilities)(Citation: Forescout Water Systems Attack)(Citation: FBI Water and Wastewater)
